title: The fact check corrected the wording
body: The page said the water runs out of the holes. `src/watering.ts:1` has the pot drain through them.
was: Pour slowly until water runs out of the drainage holes.
now: Pour slowly until water runs from the drainage holes.

title: How long the saucer stands
body: The fact check found no source for the ten minutes.

sides.text: Ten minutes is the common advice.

title: Name a pot material?
body: The page says nothing about clay or plastic.

choices.label: Add a line
choices.done: The session adds a line on materials.
